title: glyceria arundinacea subsp. triflora
intro: Glyceria arundinacea subsp. triflora, commonly known as Hard Fescue, is a perennial grass native to Europe and Asia. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria arundinacea subsp. triflora include its use in treating urinary problems, such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycerol, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
